  <section v="15">

    <t s="3">specifically "from my flesh,"</t>
    <t s="4">that the intention in this is a tangible perception</t>
    <t s="5">(of Divinity)</t>
    <t s="6">that relates to the body,</t>
    <t s="7">for the ultimate purpose of the soul's descent below is</t>
    <t s="8">(not that the soul's matters be revealed while it is clothed in the body,</t>
    <t s="9">but rather)</t>
    <t s="10">that the body will perceive Divinity.</t>
    <t s="11">[And it is noteworthy that there is another interpretation of "From my flesh I shall perceive G-d,"</t>
    <t s="12">that in the flesh itself one sees the Divinity within it.</t>
    <t s="13">And according to the teaching of the Alter Rebbe57</t>

    <t s="15">From the fact that he says one must strip the flesh</t>

    <t s="17">it is understood that through this one sees the Divinity that is in the flesh itself.</t>
    <t s="18">And as is also understood from the maamar of the Rebbe</t>
    <t s="19">(the Rebbe Rashab)</t>
    <t s="20">of blessed memory58</t>
    <t s="21">on the verse "From my flesh I shall perceive G-d,"</t>
    <t s="22">"Look not at what he is, a golem [unformed matter],</t>
    <t s="23">the golem was brought into being by the Awtsmoos of Ein Sof, blessed is He,</t>
    <t s="24">for He alone, by His power and ability, creates something from nothing and absolute naught59.</t>
    <t s="25">And it may be said,</t>
    <t s="26">that this that the maamar explains that the interpretation of "From my flesh I shall perceive G-d" is a tangible perception,</t>
    <t s="27">even though the perception of the Divinity that is in the flesh itself is seemingly a loftier matter</t>

    <t s="32">is an intellectual perception that relates to the soul,</t>
    <t s="33">and the ultimate purpose of the soul's descent below is that the body will perceive Divinity].</t>

  <section v="16">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section explains that just as the soul's descent is for the sake of ascent, so too the descent of the Divine light to create and enliven creations is a descent for the sake of ascent, resulting in a new revelation of Divinity in the physical world.</sectionSummaryBrief>

    <t s="2">Now, it is known60,</t>

    <t s="5">that it is a descent for the sake of ascent.</t>
    <t s="6">And based on this it may be said,</t>
    <t s="7">that by the Name Havayah descending and being clothed in the Name Elokim</t>
    <t s="8">(in order to bring into being and enliven the creations),</t>
    <t s="9">an ascent is effected in the light,</t>
    <t s="10">higher even than it is in its source in the Ein Sof that is above Havayah61.</t>
    <t s="11">And the ascent is,</t>
    <t s="12">that there is effected62</t>

    <t s="14">— a revelation of Divinity in this physical world.</t>
    <t s="15">And as brought above</t>
    <t s="16">(section 2)</t>
    <t s="17">from the maamar,</t>
    <t s="18">that there are matters of Divinity,</t>
    <t s="19">such as particular providence,</t>
    <t s="20">that are in actual revelation,</t>
    <t s="21">to the extent that they can be perceived tangibly.</t>
    <t s="22">And it may be said,</t>
    <t s="23">that this is what is stated in the maamar, that this tangible perception relates to the body, both regarding the person who perceives and regarding the thing perceived,</t>
    <t s="24">that the advantage of the inwardness that belongs to externality and its descent into externality is both regarding the person,</t>
    <t s="25">that the body perceives Divinity</t>
    <t s="26">(as above, section 9),</t>
    <t s="27">and regarding the light above,</t>
    <t s="28">that its revelation is in this physical world.</t>
  </section>
  <section v="17">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section explains that similarly in man's service, the descent of the intellect into the emotions causes an ascent in the intellect, and the main novelty is the arousal of the emotions, which requires preparation from the heart itself.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">10)</t>
    <t s="1">A)</t>
    <t s="2">Now, similarly is it in the service of man,</t>
    <t s="3">that through the descent of the intellects</t>
    <t s="4">[the higher aspect of man64,</t>
    <t s="5">for the nature of intellect is ascent upward]</t>
    <t s="6">into the emotions</t>
    <t s="7">[the lower aspect of man64,</t>
    <t s="8">for the nature of emotions is descent downward],</t>
    <t s="9">an ascent is effected in the intellects.</t>
    <t s="10">And the main ascent is not that the light of intellect shines also in the heart,</t>
    <t s="11">but rather that through this a new matter is effected — the arousal of the emotions.</t>
    <t s="12">And it may be said,</t>
    <t s="13">that this is the reason that in order for there to be an arousal of the emotions of the heart, there must also be preparation from the side of the heart,</t>
    <t s="14">for the main novelty in the arousal of the emotions is when the arousal is</t>
    <t s="15">(also)</t>
    <t s="16">from the aspect of the matter of the emotions.</t>

sections.sectionSummaryBrief: This section explains that the phrase "from my flesh I shall perceive G-d" refers to a tangible perception of Divinity that relates to the body, as the ultimate purpose of the soul's descent is for the body to perceive G-d, and it contrasts this with the interpretation that one sees the Divinity within the flesh itself.

translations.translation: And it may be said,
that this is what is explained in the maamar regarding the statement "From my flesh I shall perceive G-d,"
specifically "from my flesh,"
that the intention in this is a tangible perception
(of Divinity)
that relates to the body,
for the ultimate purpose of the soul's descent below is
(not that the soul's matters be revealed while it is clothed in the body,
but rather)
that the body will perceive Divinity.
[And it is noteworthy that there is another interpretation of "From my flesh I shall perceive G-d,"
that in the flesh itself one sees the Divinity within it.
And according to the teaching of the Alter Rebbe57
on the verse "From my flesh I shall perceive G-d," that one must strip the flesh so that one should see G-dliness.
From the fact that he says one must strip the flesh
(removing the covering things)
it is understood that through this one sees the Divinity that is in the flesh itself.
And as is also understood from the maamar of the Rebbe
(the Rebbe Rashab)
of blessed memory58
on the verse "From my flesh I shall perceive G-d,"
"Look not at what he is, a golem [unformed matter],
the golem was brought into being by the Awtsmoos of Ein Sof, blessed is He,
for He alone, by His power and ability, creates something from nothing and absolute naught59.
And it may be said,
that this that the maamar explains that the interpretation of "From my flesh I shall perceive G-d" is a tangible perception,
even though the perception of the Divinity that is in the flesh itself is seemingly a loftier matter
(and especially according to the interpretation of the Rebbe of blessed memory, which refers to the power of the Awtsmoos within the body),
it is,
because the perception of the Divinity that is in the flesh
(the power of the Awtsmoos within it)
is an intellectual perception that relates to the soul,
and the ultimate purpose of the soul's descent below is that the body will perceive Divinity].

sections.sectionSummaryBrief: This section explains that just as the soul's descent is for the sake of ascent, so too the descent of the Divine light to create and enliven creations is a descent for the sake of ascent, resulting in a new revelation of Divinity in the physical world.

translations.translation: And 4)
Now, it is known60,
that just as the descent of the soul below is for the sake of ascent,
so too is it regarding the descent of the Divine light to bring into being and enliven the creations,
that it is a descent for the sake of ascent.
And based on this it may be said,
that by the Name Havayah descending and being clothed in the Name Elokim
(in order to bring into being and enliven the creations),
an ascent is effected in the light,
higher even than it is in its source in the Ein Sof that is above Havayah61.
And the ascent is,
that there is effected62
in it a new matter63
— a revelation of Divinity in this physical world.
And as brought above
(section 2)
from the maamar,
that there are matters of Divinity,
such as particular providence,
that are in actual revelation,
to the extent that they can be perceived tangibly.
And it may be said,
that this is what is stated in the maamar, that this tangible perception relates to the body, both regarding the person who perceives and regarding the thing perceived,
that the advantage of the inwardness that belongs to externality and its descent into externality is both regarding the person,
that the body perceives Divinity
(as above, section 9),
and regarding the light above,
that its revelation is in this physical world.

sections.sectionSummaryBrief: This section explains that similarly in man's service, the descent of the intellect into the emotions causes an ascent in the intellect, and the main novelty is the arousal of the emotions, which requires preparation from the heart itself.

translations.translation: A)
Now, similarly is it in the service of man,
that through the descent of the intellects
[the higher aspect of man64,
for the nature of intellect is ascent upward]
into the emotions
[the lower aspect of man64,
for the nature of emotions is descent downward],
an ascent is effected in the intellects.
And the main ascent is not that the light of intellect shines also in the heart,
but rather that through this a new matter is effected — the arousal of the emotions.
And it may be said,
that this is the reason that in order for there to be an arousal of the emotions of the heart, there must also be preparation from the side of the heart,
for the main novelty in the arousal of the emotions is when the arousal is
(also)
from the aspect of the matter of the emotions.
